steps.content: The blonde hair sways in the wind. The woman in front of you finally reveals her real face.
She smiles and cups her hands on your face.

steps.speaker: Blonde Woman
steps.content: Then remember it now. We'll see each other again when it's all over.
Gunshots sound. Several monsters fall off instantly, leaving a hole in the wall of white flesh, through which you see Nightingale with her gun aimed at you.
The blonde woman laughs. You feel the grip on your body loosens, then you fall onto the flesh below and are quickly caught by Hecate.
In the meantime, the defeated white monster suddenly stands up and flaps its wings, creating an overwhelming gust.
In the midst of the smoke and dust, the woman slowly walks toward the creature.

steps.speaker: Blonde Woman
steps.content: The secret will be revealed one day, but not now.

steps.speaker: Blonde Woman
steps.content:
Look at your cities. Look at what monsters human sin is breeding...
This is the final revelry you will enjoy.
In the end, she looks over at you and gives you that familiar smile again.

steps.speaker: Blonde Woman
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, go witness the end of this revelry. Whatever happens, don't look away. If you can do it...

steps.speaker: Blonde Woman
steps.content: I'll be waiting for you at the end with all the answers you have been looking for.
The white monster rises in a powerful current of air and breaks through the dome, disappearing into the night sky.
